doc: Main frame-pump loop. Repeatedly polls pad/state via func_80053EF0(1); returns immediately once it reports 0. On the very first nonzero poll only (guarded by a one-shot `flag`), if the reported value isn't 3, fires a one-time func_80053DA8(0xC1) event. Every iteration then calls func_80044618(2), waits on VSync(1), extracts a 9-bit field (bits 15:8, masked to 0x1FF... actually (result>>8)&0x1FF) from the vsync return value, and updates the gp-relative global D_80080B00 only when that field changes from its previous value.

globals.decl: extern u16 D_80080B00; // gp_rel (%gp_rel(D_80080B00)($gp)), 2-byte scalar, unsigned (lhu/sh load-compare-store of a 9-bit field 0..0x1FF)
